content:
**Blight Soup** is a consumable item in *Fallout 76*.

A soup made from Blight and Boiled Water and cooked with wood. When consumed it gives a 20% boost to Critical Damage, satisfies a moderate amount of hunger and thirst, and heals a large amount of Hit Points at the cost of a moderate amount of Radiation.

| Materials: | | Requirements: | | Produces: | 
| Blight (1) Boiled Water (1) Wood (1) | | **Build at:****Learn Method:**Learned on pickup Blight | | Blight Soup (1) |
